plain: The condition under which information may pass on, such as in confidence, with consent or as the law requires.
eli5: Telling a secret "only if you promise not to tell anyone".
technical: The contextual-integrity parameter stating the condition on a flow (in confidence, with consent, reciprocally, with notice, as required by law); it belongs to the flow, not to whoever ordered it, carries much of the theory's normative weight, and has no closed list.
